prompt: Brush drawing is super laggy on an 8192x8192 canvas but totally smooth on a 256x256 sprite. I'm on Windows. How do I figure out where the time is actually going before I start changing things?

assertions.text: Recommends the release-with-debug profile for profiling (release opts + debug symbols, not dev, not stripped release)
Recommends samply as the cross-platform/Windows profiler (no perf/sudo), with cargo flamegraph as an alternative
Explains how to read a flamegraph (widest box = most CPU time)
Diagnoses likely canvas-tool causes: full-canvas pass that should be dirty-rect-bounded, per-move buffer clone, or work on the egui frame thread
Does not jump straight to a code rewrite without profiling first
